name: Implement nf-visual: vi-inspired modal for nameforma mutations
summary: Vi-inspired modal interface for browsing and mutating nameforma entities. Navigation: j/k moves cursor up/down through entity list, zo/zc zooms detail level in/out, / searches forward, ? searches backward. Each line represents a uuid64-identified entity. Mutations: edit, delete, create, link commands (keybindings TBD).
